title: The Ruins First Appear
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji tucked the broken stele into his sleeve, in the imperial capital a thousand miles away, a secret meeting concerning the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion ruins was being convened, and the Crown Prince's next move had already fallen onto Chen Ji's chessboard.

text.content: Chen Ji crouched down, brushing away the dust on the broken stele with his fingers. The lingering glow of the setting sun gilded those two characters in gold and crimson, as if summoning him to uncover the dust-laden history. He took a deep breath, suppressing the trembling in his heart, and began carefully deciphering the dense small characters beneath the inscription. Wind blew from the depths of the rift, carrying a faint trace of sandalwood, lending this desolate place an added sense of the uncanny.

dialogue.content: Heavenly Secrets Pavilion... Established in the year of Wuzi, opens when the rift appears, those who defy heaven may enter.

text.content: The characters on the broken stele were ancient and faded. Drawing on the residual memories from the Tianji Record Fragment, Chen Ji painstakingly deciphered each character. "Rift" meant the crack, while "defying heaven" referred to those who cultivated the Tianji Record. The entire sentence meant: the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion ruins opened when the rift appeared, but only those who cultivated the Tianji Record could enter. He raised his head, his gaze sweeping across the terrain at the edge of the rift, and a plan was already forming in his mind.

As he continued reading downward, Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly. The final lines of the inscription made him draw a sharp breath—those entering the rift must use Heavenly Fate as a guide, each layer consumed ten points of Heavenly Fate. The rift had nine layers, nine times nine returning to one, before the true face of Heavenly Secrets could be seen. And the Heavenly Fate value he had remaining was barely twenty-three points at most.

dialogue.content: Twenty-three points... not even enough to enter the third layer.

text.content: Chen Ji stood up, his gaze deep and dark as he stared at that dim rift. The inscriptions on the stele gradually aligned with the hints in the Tianji Record Fragment—this ruin was a dojo left behind by successive inheritors of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion after their fall, containing key secret treasures to repair the Tianji Record. Yet the cost was far beyond his expectations. He clenched his fist, his knuckles whitening from the force, and the blurry face of his sister Chen Nian flashed through his mind.

Just then, the communication talisman in his sleeve grew warm. Chen Ji's brow lifted as he retrieved the talisman, on which appeared a line of golden script: 'The Crown Prince has urgent matters to discuss, please proceed to the embassy, Mr. Chen.' At the end was a vermillion Crown Prince's personal seal. He gave a cold laugh and tucked the talisman back into his sleeve. That was fast—the collapse of the dragon's vein was indeed too significant an event to hide from that man's eyes.

choice.prompt: The information on the broken stele was confirmed, but the cost of entering the ruins far exceeded expectations. Now the Crown Prince had sent someone to contact him, inquiring about the dragon's vein and the rift. How should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Go personally to the embassy to meet the Crown Prince
choices.description: Since the Crown Prince had taken the initiative to show goodwill, it meant the dragon's vein matter still had exploitable value. Going personally would demonstrate sincerity while also allowing him to take the initiative in negotiations and probe the Crown Prince's hidden cards.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes half a day, may expose one's whereabouts
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Crown Prince's trust, establish cooperative relations
choices.risk_hint: The Crown Prince is extremely calculating, and any careless remark in conversation could lead one into a trap

text.content: Chen Ji carefully placed the broken stele into his storage bag, straightened his clothes, and headed toward the embassy. Before leaving, he left a hidden tracking mark on an ancient pine at the edge of the rift—this was a backup plan he had left for the future.

As twilight gathered, Chen Ji stepped into the Crown Prince's embassy. The Crown Prince personally waited in the main hall, greeting him with a broad smile: 'Mr. Chen, you labored hard on your journey to the dragon's vein. I have prepared a modest wine to welcome you.' Chen Ji clasped his hands in greeting, appearing respectful on the surface while rapidly calculating the Crown Prince's true intentions in his heart.

choices.text: Make excuses to avoid meeting, send trusted confidants to gather information
choices.description: Now is not the time for a direct confrontation with the Crown Prince. Send a trusted confidant to the embassy under the pretense of visiting illness, while continuing to research the broken stele and information about the ruin's entrance, secretly observing the Crown Prince's movements.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to build trust with the Crown Prince
choices.visible_reward: Maintain a low profile, gather more information
choices.risk_hint: If the Crown Prince perceives neglect, he may take offense

text.content: Chen Ji took out a substitution talisman, infusing it with spiritual energy to activate it. The talisman transformed into his likeness and flew toward the embassy. His true self concealed himself in the shadows, continuing to contemplate the inscriptions on the broken stele. The substitute puppet was sufficient to handle ordinary inquiries, and what he needed was time.

Late at night, the substitute puppet sent back a message: the Crown Prince expressed 'deep concern' over the collapse of the dragon's vein, asked whether Chen Ji needed imperial assistance, and hinted that if Chen Ji was willing to serve the court, the Crown Prince could provide the 'special materials' needed to enter the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion ruins. After hearing this, Chen Ji laughed coldly—sure enough, there was no such thing as a free lunch in this world.

choices.text: Propose conditions, demand the Crown Prince make the first move
choices.description: Not revealing the hand without seeing the prey. Through talisman, reply to the Crown Prince, expressing willingness to meet, but requiring the Crown Prince to first show sincerity—the intelligence regarding the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion ruins.
choices.visible_cost: Risk infuriating the Crown Prince, losing court protection
choices.visible_reward: Test the Crown Prince's cards, strive for favorable conditions
choices.risk_hint: If the Crown Prince refuses, negotiations will reach a deadlock

text.content: Chen Ji wrote several lines on the talisman: "Regarding the ruins, Chen does indeed possess some insight. However, this matter carries tremendous significance and cannot be fully expressed in mere words. If Your Highness has sincerity, why not first share the court's perspective on this matter?" The talisman transformed into flowing light and flew away. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, awaiting a reply.

Shortly after, the Crown Prince replied: "Young Master Chen is indeed prudent. This palace does indeed possess an ancient classic regarding the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, which records part of the ruins' structure. If the young master is interested, you may visit the courier station to examine it." Chen Ji narrowed his eyes—this old fox, revealing his hand right away, is this a test or genuine eagerness to recruit talent?

No matter which path he chose, Chen Ji understood one crucial point: this ruins before him held the key to enhancing his strength and finding his sister Chen Nian. Yet with his Heavenly Fate value nearly depleted, recklessly entering would be tantamount to seeking his own death. He needed to devise a prudent strategy that would allow him to secure the opportunities within the ruins without excessively consuming his remaining Heavenly Fate.

Chen Ji once again gazed at that dark fissure, a resolute glint flickering across his eyes. He retrieved a jet-black formation disk from his storage bag—a covert piece he had laid down long ago, known as the "Shadow Guard." By activating this formation disk, he could deploy a surveillance network spanning a hundred li, ensuring that no subtle movement escaped his vigilance.

Spiritual energy coursed into the formation disk, causing intricate runes to surface across its exterior before transforming into a wisp of black smoke that seeped into the rocks and soil surrounding the fissure. Satisfied with this arrangement, Chen Ji nodded. Though he couldn't yet enter the ruins, this strategic piece would guarantee him real-time awareness of the entrance's movements, preventing him from missing crucial opportunities.

choice.prompt: The surveillance piece has been strategically positioned, yet the ruins' entrance appears to require a specific moment to open. Chen Ji must determine his next course of action.

choices.text: Return to the sect and plan strategically
choices.description: Currently lacking sufficient intelligence, hasty actions would only reveal weaknesses. Upon returning to the Tianqing Sect, he could acquire more information about the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion from Mo Xiansheng while covertly building his strength.
choices.visible_cost: Risk missing the unstable period when the ruins initially open
choices.visible_reward: Unlocking Mo Xiansheng's knowledge, mastering more secrets of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Undercurrents surge within the sect, the old sect master Ling Yuan watches with predatory intent

text.content: Chen Ji turned and set foot on his return journey. Night wind brushed against his robes, bringing a chill. His pace seemed leisurely, but his divine sense constantly enveloped his surroundings, vigilant against possible pursuers. Upon returning to the sect, all actions must be more cautious—especially when facing that old sect master who hid daggers behind his smile.

choices.text: Stay near the ruins, bide time for the opportune moment
choices.description: When the ruins first open, it will inevitably attract covetous eyes from all quarters. Staying here allows one to grasp intelligence at the earliest moment, and to find exploitable opportunities amid the chaos.
choices.visible_cost: Exposure risk greatly increases, possible encounter with powerful enemies
choices.visible_reward: Be the first to discover the crucial node of the ruins' opening
choices.risk_hint: Masters from the Demonic Path and Xuanwu Sect may appear at any moment

text.content: Chen Ji found a secluded cave and sat cross-legged. His divine sense connected to the Shadow Guard formation disk, all movements within a hundred li under his control. The night deepened, and occasionally from the fissure came low rumbling sounds, as if something was awakening. He opened his eyes, his gaze profound and deep as an abyss.

choices.text: Contact Ye Qing, borrow the power of the Demonic Path
choices.description: Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record, serving as perfect assistance for exploring the ruins. Collaborating with the Demonic Path Saint, though risky, offers equally substantial rewards.
choices.visible_cost: may deepen the rift with the righteous path
choices.visible_reward: gain the concealment of demonic path mist, significantly reducing the risk of ruins exploration
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing has the Holy Sect behind her, cooperating with her is no different than making a pact with the tiger

text.content: Chen Ji took out a completely black transmission talisman and injected spiritual energy into it. After a moment, Ye Qing's languid voice came from the other end of the talisman: 'Young Master Chen, sending a transmission in the middle of the night, could it be you miss me?' He slightly raised the corner of his mouth and got straight to the point: 'The Tianji Pavilion ruins, I need your demonic path mist.' After a brief silence from the other end of the talisman, a soft laugh followed: 'Interesting, when and where?'

While Chen Ji was contemplating, in the Crown Prince's palace far away in the imperial capital, the candle flames flickered. The Crown Prince stood with hands behind his back, before him knelt a black-clad figure, quietly reporting something.

The Crown Prince slowly turned around, a glint of sharp intelligence flashing in his eyes: 'The Tianji Pavilion ruins... interesting. It seems this Young Master Chen is more valuable than I imagined. Issue the order - secretly monitor the movements of the rift. If Chen Ji shows any unusual activity, report immediately.' The black-clad figure accepted the order and vanished into the night. The Crown Prince gazed at the bright moon outside the hall, a meaningful smile curving his lips.

At the same time, deep within the Tianji Record fragment, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly. He sensed Chen Ji's discovery of the ruins, and a complex expression appeared on his aged face.

dialogue.content: Tianji Pavilion... that child has finally reached this point.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a mix of expectation and worry: 'Chen Ji, you've done well. But there is one thing you must remember - the core of the Tianji Pavilion is no ordinary fortune. What lies there is enough to draw the attention of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao.' Chen Ji heard this, his heart tightening, and pressed: 'The Eyes of Heavenly Dao? What is that?' Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, then uttered four words - 'The Limit of Heavenly Secrets'.

The night wind howled, Chen Ji stood at the edge of the rift, holding the sub-symbol of the Shadow Guard formation disk in his hand. From afar came faint traces of spiritual energy fluctuation, as if someone was testing the boundary of the rift. He narrowed his eyes and stored the formation disk into his sleeve.

The chess game has been set, the pieces have been placed. The opening of the Tianji Pavilion ruins is imminent. And Chen Ji will certainly, in this chaotic chess game of the era, place his pieces and stir up the winds and clouds. Deep within the rift, that ancient and mysterious aura grew increasingly intense, as if something was awakening, waiting for his arrival.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng revealed the existence of the 'Eyes of Heavenly Dao' and mentioned that the Tianji Pavilion contains world-shocking secrets. Chen Ji needs to make his final decision.

choices.text: Temporarily leave, return after improving strength
choices.description: Currently lacking sufficient strength, recklessly entering the ruins would only mean death. Return to the sect first for devoted cultivation, wait until the Heavenly Fate value recovers and strength improves, then make plans.
choices.visible_cost: The fortune within the ruins may be taken by others first
choices.risk_hint: The longer it is delayed, the more variables arise

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. He cast one final glance at that dark rift, then turned and fled toward the sect. Before leaving, he checked the operation of the Shadow Guard formation disk once more, only feeling at ease after confirming everything was normal. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in his mind - The Limit of Heavenly Secrets, what kind of secrets does it hold? He looked forward to the day when the answers would be revealed.

choices.text: Take the risk and enter the ruins under the cover of night
choices.description: The opportunity is fleeting, when the ruins first open the defenses will surely be lax. While the various forces haven't reacted yet, be the first to rush into the first layer and obtain key intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate value, may fall into danger
choices.visible_reward: First to obtain the core intelligence of the ruins, seize the initiative
choices.risk_hint: With current Heavenly Fate value, can only support reaching the third layer at most

text.content: A determined glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as he lifted his foot toward the rift. Since he would inevitably enter it eventually, he might as well go when the night was deepest and the defenses weakest. He took a protective talisman from his storage bag and activated it, then used spiritual energy to shield his heart meridian, fully preparing himself. The moment he stepped into the rift, a surge of powerful spiritual energy rushed toward him, nearly knocking him off his feet.

At the edge of the rift, Chen Ji stopped, casting one final look back at the mountains shrouded in twilight behind him. His gaze penetrated through layers of night, seemingly staring at a distant figure - that was his sister Chen Nian who had been missing for years. The sub-symbol of the Shadow Guard formation disk in his sleeve faintly pulsed with warmth, reminding him that everything was under control.

Chen Ji tucked the broken stele into his sleeve, a faint, composed smile curling at the corner of his lips. No matter which path he chose, he would never let fate control his own chess game. The ruins of Tianji Pavilion, the collapse of the dragon vein, the Crown Prince's overtures, Mo Xiansheng's warnings... all of this was within his calculations. The next volume of the chess game was about to begin. And Chen Ji would take heaven and earth as his chessboard, the multitude as his chess pieces, and write his own legend.
